lines: | **`benchmark/2026-10-03-u16-flutter-impeller-proc/`** | **Flutter Impeller GLES ProcTable pc=0 named (cc-t3, U16): slot #468 = `glDepthRange` on localsend build-id 0d216f3f. The OH Mali driver has no `glDepthRange` in any form (eglGetProcAddress + dlsym NULL; only `glDepthRangef` exists), so the fix is an `eglGetProcAddress` interposer in `westlake_flutter/libandroid.so` (U14's level-1 object, new file) that shims glDepthRange/glClearDepth to the f-variant, dlsym-forwards the 41 ext procs, stubs the rest. The 4 Flutter keys are 4 different engine builds (not a shared slot) but one interposer covers the gap class; predicted movers 4.** |

- 2026-10-03 **Flutter Impeller pc=0 槽 #468 = glDepthRange,驱动无此函数任何形式(cc-t3,U16)**:localsend libflutter(build-id 0d216f3f —— 外环给的 0d216f3f 是 GNU build-id 不是 sha256,sha256 0c56c4a4)首帧 1.raster 崩在 +0x4b655c(`adrp x9,0xaee000; ldr x8,[x9,#0xea0]; blr x8`,x9=.bss ProcTable,0xea0=slot #468)。静态定槽名=glDepthRange:Phase1 构造 entry 0xe88 的 .name=0x1bcc64『glDepthRange』(40B stride,0xea0=entry+0x18),Phase2 resolver(包 eglGetProcAddress)返 NULL 时 cbz 跳过存储→槽 0→blr 0。板上驱动 oracle(5cd OH6.1 Mali v1.r32p0):glDepthRange/glClearDepth 在 eglGetProcAddress 与 libGLESv2/v3 dlsym **全 NULL**(是 desktop-GL 双精度入口,GLES 只有 glDepthRangef/glClearDepthf 且都导出)——修法是**语义桩 glDepthRange→glDepthRangef**,不是 2026-09-28 RE 的 dlsym 直转(那会把它变 no-op)。4 个 Flutter 键是 4 个不同 engine build(build-id 各异:localsend 0d216f3f/kitchenowl 889a1df3/fluffychat 495e7110/libre=saber fdf0a0a6),崩溃偏移/槽号按 build 走、**不共享**;但都引用 glDepthRange+导入 eglGetProcAddress+Impeller→同一个 eglGetProcAddress interposer(落在 U14 的 westlake_flutter/libandroid.so,新函数新文件)覆盖整类,预计移 4。规则:proc 名不决定修法,查驱动两端(eglGetProcAddress+dlsym);『同偏移崩』需 build-id 相同;崩溃给的 hash 对不上 sha 时按 GNU build-id 匹配。
